digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions bridge workflows and core push delivery
propositions: Both reconcile-bridge and reconcile-bridge-canary workflows must delegate to core push entrypoints instead of inline CAS loops.
Strict workflow delivery remains synchronous and red on exhausted failure; core owns retry and CAS recovery logic.
Reconciler author identity, exact commit subject, and bot identity are preserved through the migration.
Raw-git exemption and workflow-local CAS loops are removed; Python library and MCP defaults remain best-effort.
Tests must verify single complete core push action per workflow, preserved red disposition on rejection, and absence of inline fetch/merge/retry.
Stale synthetic raw-git fixture rationale is replaced with generic reviewed-workflow documentation.
